'''Weller''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] agent stationed on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He had assigned [[Commando Team Seven]] with defusing a series of bombs that the Republic had provided to one of the swoop gangs on Taris during the [[Jedi Civil War]]. The squad of soldiers was killed by [[Rakghoul]]s but a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] spacer came across the teams [[Holocomm/Legends|holocommunicator]] and was subsequently recruited by Weller to finish the mission.<ref name="Future Threat" />
